output.explanation: Implemented all eleven B02 edits using the pinned sources and authoritative preceding canvases. Repository identity now connects workspace/catalog persistence, isolated ChangeSession capture, separately stored DiffTree evidence, compact APIs, coverage and inline migration review. Existing history, receipts, immediate exec mutations, guarded atomic acceptance and review limitations are preserved. Runtime projection sends arrows behind diagrams. Evidence contains exactly 40 concept lines; Runtime retains 36. All diagrams fit their scaffold rectangles. The five edges retain batch order. These changes establish the evidence foundation for later bidirectional navigation, treemaps and automated DiffSession capture without portraying those later features as implemented.
